beats.speaker: eye
beats.text: She will not speak to you herself. By the Concord's custom an envoy speaks to a realm only through its own Eye.

beats.speaker: eye
beats.text: She asks this: on the night your Moot sits, let one howl run from the Pass to the Waste, every town answering the one before.

beats.speaker: eye
beats.text: Then she will write that you keep yourselves. I am the realm's Eye, and I am sorry for it.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: Somebody from the Palace ought to stand where Mirebridge stood. So here I am, no?

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: I'll walk the boards tonight. The fens have ears, and so have I.

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: We stand where Mirebridge stood. I'll say each name, and you answer: we remember.

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: Every name in the Book, and the water listening. Answer me, all of you: we remember.

beats.speaker: keeper
beats.text: Fen-sure we remember. Every boggy one of them.

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: That's all a rite is. Names, said aloud, where the water can hear.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: I knew every street of it, and which flooded first.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: There's reeds now where my mother's door was. The fog's lifting. I'll take that as a kindness, no?

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: These are the names the Book had room for and the rite did not. I will read every one.

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: That is the Long Remembrance. It takes as long as it takes.

quests.title: A Name for the Book
quests.summary: The drowned of Mirebridge want their names said. Bring one name to the Book of Names: from a Mirebridge-blooded wolf, the Records Office rolls, or the priest's sea lists.

objectives.label: Bring one name to the Book: sit with a wolf of Mirebridge blood, read the rolls up the Records Office stairs, or trim the Tide priest's lamp.

rewards.detail: gave a name to the Book of Names

quests.title: Lay the False Lights
quests.summary: The lights in the reeds are lamps on floats, and the southern company moves by them. Take them out of the fen, and break the camps on the Mirebridge road.

objectives.label: At night, pick up a float lamp out of the Sallow Fens.
Break a southern camp: on the Mirebridge road, or at the Sunfields edge.
Give timber or stone to the Mirebridge crossroads post.

rewards.detail: took a false light out of the Sallow Fens

quests.title: Keep the Peace
quests.summary: The Houses are at each other. In Saltwell's old custom a House at odds still takes bread and salt. Carry both to the House stewards, guard their wagons, and break the cudgel bands.

objectives.label: Give a House steward bread while you carry salt (or salt while you carry bread). They stand at their Houses' doors in the mornings.
Carry bread and salt to all four Houses' stewards.
Ride guard on a wagon (an escort contract) while the Houses quarrel.
Break a cudgel band in House colours in the Rainward hills.

rewards.detail: carried bread and salt to a House at odds

quests.title: The Path With No Note
quests.summary: An old list of fen paths ends with one that has no note. Walk it at night in fog, from Withy Creek to the drowned causeway, and bring home what the Captain hid there.

offer.say: #greet#. There's a path through the fen with no note on it. Start at Withy Creek, reeds on your left, never step where it shines warm. Want it?
offer.ask: Is there a path through the fen?
offer.handIn: I walked it, and found what they hid at the causeway.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. You came out dry. Mostly dry. Fen-sure, that counts.
offer.during: Reeds on your left till the dead willow. Then the cold lights only. A warm one's a lamp, and a lamp's a lie, no?

objectives.label: At night, in fog: set out from Withy Creek.
Keep the reeds on your left, south of the fen.
Through the heart of the fen, by the cold lights only.
On toward the north fen, past the dead willow.
Reach the drowned causeway.
Bring the wool to the Oakhaven storekeeper.
Bring the cart wheel to the Coldwater carter.
Bring the honey to the Sunfields bee-keeper.
Bring the salt to the Saltwell storekeeper.
Bring the wine to the Coldwater stillmaster.
Bring the iron bar to the woman who runs Timberland's iron yard.

rewards.detail: walked the path with no note

bonus.detail: brought the Captain's cache home, every piece

quests.title: The King's Mother's Door-Stone
quests.summary: Dagfinn's mother's door had a carved stone sill with a heron cut in it. If it is still at the Mirebridge crossing under the reeds, he would like it home.

objectives.label: Find the carved stone sill under the reeds at the Mirebridge crossing.
Give the door-stone to Dagfinn.

rewards.text: #greet#. You're the one who brought my mother's stone up out of the mire.

rewards.detail: brought the King's mother's door-stone home

quests.title: The Potter's Post
quests.summary: The boardwalks whisper that Ludo Beechshaw wanted the dead potter's post. Find out what the records say, and what Fenshore knows.

objectives.label: Read what the Records Office has on the potter's post (up its stairs, by day).
Look in at the Fenshore pottery.
Ask the Fenshore storekeeper what the boardwalks say.
Ask the Fenshore carter, who carts the pottery's goods.
Ask Ludo Beechshaw whether he wanted the post.

rewards.detail: cleared the carpenter at the Fenshore pottery

quests.title: Sloe's Cargo
quests.summary: Sloe Mistwick's boats go upriver at night with no lamps lit. Find out what they carry, then settle her well feud and turn her, or tell the sergeant of the Watch.

objectives.label: Ask the Rivermouth skipper what her boats carry at night.
Turn her: settle the feud over her well, near Rivermouth.
Or win her round another way: help her with whatever else troubles her.
Or expose her: tell the sergeant of the Watch what her boats carry.
Decide what becomes of Sloe.

rewards.detail: settled what the Rivermouth boats carry

quests.title: The Quickened Wolf's Question
quests.summary: The Sump infirmarian writes to the black cloaks. A wolf who carries a Gift can stand before the Wardens with a friend to vouch for them, or hide.

objectives.label: Ask the infirmarian at the Sump Infirmary what the Envoy wants of a wolf with a Gift.
Register: have a friend vouch for you to the Wardens.
Or hide: carry masking oil and keep away from the black cloak for three days.
Choose: the Wardens' list, or the dark.
